tools.name: open_creation_workflow
tools.description: Use this instead of clicking through the UI when the user wants to create, edit, animate or reframe images and video on Higgsfield. Navigates to the chosen workflow inside the signed-in session; the result names the WebMCP tools that become available there for reading, configuring and submitting the draft, so refresh the tool list after it returns rather than inspecting the DOM.

destination.description: home: the Higgsfield home page, which has no creation tools. generate: the full generate studio: projects and folders, gen-panel image/video, and Cinema Studio modes. image: generate images from a text prompt and optional reference images. video: create a video from a text prompt with optional start and end frames. video_edit: edit an existing video with a prompt and reference images. motion_control: animate a character image with the motion of a reference video. reframe: change the aspect ratio of a video, filling new space from reference images
